claims.scope: Perl compiler membership only. Original literal scalar intervals, event/argument references, family/occurrence order, dependencies and caller errors remain fixture authority. Production, Perl fixtures, CI, hooks and dependencies remain unchanged. The historical evidence auditor admits only the committed af5d/31395 one-line scanner-mock correction through a whole-file Git-bound inverse; original milestone/log/input/claim bytes and hashes remain exact. The first canonical failure and its complete staged binary patch are retained; the original auditor still reproduces that exact drift rejection. A second complete canonical failure and candidate are retained and expose the existing callable fixture regression. This record covers the original bounded fixture/consumer population and the actual three-source callable diagnosis, not full compiler compatibility. Original AST/signatures, real producer origins, substitutions/dumps/emitted modules and native/fresh value/error channels distinguish signature masking from the earlier repaired splitter. The transparent observer delegates exactly once to actual SourceMembership callbacks without replacing the real dependency map. Its original last-empty-packet version rejects for missing origins; the initial direct facade-bundle probe exits255, and exact retained-source replay attributes it to missing LinkedSpec::_split_action_ir_statements. Compiler repair .0.2.2.1 and fresh committed canonical .0.2.2.2 remain open. The later .0.4 owner retains its recurring-registration ledger work. Complete regular immutable Git input superset at864b1a93934ab7fd4b059b0a7cb9d4b417e33c66 is reconstructed without overlays and hash/mode/population guarded before and after every command. All supplied inputs recover from the retained exact object/content/mode manifests and Git; this is not minimal observed IO. Public channels recur under three controlled seeds from the unchanged original22-source producer; all channels equal the committed integration capture except the explicitly controlled seed. Two original no-value-oracle cases retain full channels without inventing success acceptance. Existing38-group compiler RED is reverified through its original retained historical inputs/reviewer, not regenerated against current compiler owners. Membership parent .0.2 remains open until corrected committed .0.2.2.2 and exact staged canonical receipt/normal hooks; this record publishes no canonical CI measurement. Precise replacement .0.3, diagnostic origin .7.2.2.1, comments .7.3, recurring executable .0.4 and broader quote/backend/audit scopes remain open. The original compiler claim was already historical ataf5d19971 by REPO-HYGIENE.11; all original hashes/boundary remain unchanged. Initial review instrument incorrectly assumed a live claim; its original source and actual assertion rejection are retained and independently recur. The first full-permission guard and the ineffective nested-line consumer control also remain as original producers with complete actual rejected channels; the 0640/100644 permission counterexample is retained as a reconstructable input. Current root checks use Git executable mode; full reconstructed snapshot permissions remain hash/mode guarded before and after every actual observation command. Retained original source executes with its original __file__ identity for artifact lookup; direct stored-filename invocation and its wrong-prefix rejection also recur. Actual producer/input channels, complete immutable manifests and full publication capsule retain durability and are claim-gated. Necessary OS/Perl/Python/mdBook/toolchain reads only; project data remains repository-local/same-volume. Other repositories read-only, Gitlinks/nonregular payloads excluded without inspection, RGX/PGEN black boxes. No wrapper recovery/purge, readiness waiver or new grammar/backend admission.
